items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I was sort of in it already while I was at Berklee. Around ’94 I started playing with a big band... it was called Kendrick Oliver New Life Jazz Orchestra... I was one of the original guys

ctx.x: So after you got out of Berklee, how did you sort of get into the music scene, or try to — what was the first step in trying to make a living at it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

I was sort of in it already while I was at Berklee. Around ’94 I started playing with a big band, well it was many other things, but there was a jazz big band at Berklee and it was called Kendrick Oliver New Life Jazz Orchestra.
